= sections-inline-roles(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-08-30
:mansource: acdc
:manmanual: Section and inline checks

== NAME

sections-inline-roles - verify section and inline presentation

== SYNOPSIS

sections-inline-roles

== DESCRIPTION

See <<hidden-section>> and <<visible-child>>.

[#hidden-section%notitle]
=== Hidden *Section*

The hidden section body remains visible.

[#visible-child]
==== Visible Child

The child body remains visible.

=== Link display

Before: https://before.example/path[] and link:https://before.example/linked[].

:hide-uri-scheme:

Hidden schemes: https://hidden.example/path[], link:https://hidden.example/linked[], and https://hidden.example/auto.

Explicit text: link:https://hidden.example/label[visible label].

:hide-uri-scheme!:

After: https://after.example/path[].

=== Link roles

Roles: https://example.com/underline[underlined,role=underline], link:https://example.com/deleted[removed,role=line-through], link:https://example.com/large[large,role=big], mailto:person@example.com[small,role=small], and link:https://example.com/combined[combined,role="underline line-through"].

=== Inline roles

Roles: #highlighted#, [#targeted]#targeted#, [.underline]#underlined#, [.line-through]#removed#, [.big]#large#, [.small]#small#, [.subtitle]#subtitle#, [.overline]#overlined#, [.custom]#custom#, and [.underline.line-through]#combined#.
